text: いま　わたしの　ほう　みたでしょ

patterns.name: 〜でしょう
patterns.explanation: でしょう at the end pushes the listener to agree, like 'didn't you?'; でしょ is the short spoken form. みたでしょ = 'you looked, didn't you?'

patterns.name: 〜のほう
patterns.explanation: のほう after a person or thing means 'in the direction of'. わたしの ほう = 'my way'.
